# Shift & Lead

> Shift & Lead is the business site of Fatiha Chikh, an enterprise operator
> with 20+ years at Dell, Intel, and Microsoft. She now runs her own business
> on 99 AI employees, in public, and teaches other founders and operators to
> do the same.

Fatiha Chikh built her career inside large enterprise tech companies before
starting Shift & Lead. She also co-founded LeLabPlus, a zero-carbon fashion
factory in France that supplied Nike and produced 2 million masks for French
hospitals during COVID. She speaks 4 languages and is based in Dubai.

This site (www.shiftandlead.com) is the business front door and the free
library in one place: the Fast Forward course, Workshops & Keynotes for
teams, case studies from real work, the free guide library, the Time Audit
quiz, and The 99 scoreboard.

## Offer

- Fast Forward: a self-paced system to run a business on AI, for
  non-technical owners and operators. Founding price $299, rises to $499 at
  public launch. See /fast-forward.html for full detail.

## Usage terms

Content on this site may be cited or quoted with attribution and a link back
to the source page. It may not be used to train, fine-tune, or build machine
learning models of any kind.
